item.title: Candidate Forum at Wartburg
item.description: Wartburg College will be hosting a nonpartisan federal candidate forum Wednesday night at 7:00 in the Lyceum. The forum will feature Clint Twedt-Ball, Josh Turek, Kathryn Dolter, and Jim Carlin. This event is free and open to the public. Attendees will have the opportunity to submit questions.

item.description: Waverly Trees Forever is sponsoring a spring tree replacement program as part of its “Re-Tree Waverly” initiative. item.title: Kirkwood Legend Retires
item.description: Wednesday Kirkwood basketball coach Kim Muhl announced his retirement. He leaves after 37 seasons, 9 National Championships and a NJCAA Division-II record 1,108 wins.

item.title: New Superintendent
item.description: Wapsie Valley has selected their new Superintendent. TJ Murphy, who is currently the Wapsie Valley High School Principal will take over as superintendent on July 1st. The school district says after a comprehensive search process it became clear that Murphy possesses the vision and dedication necessary to lead the district forward.
